description: On the bed in front of the hands, there’s a white AirPods case with a white charging cable nearby. The right hand moves in to grasp and steady the AirPods case as a right-hand object while the left hand slides in from the left to pinch the cable’s connector as a left-hand object, guiding it into and then back out of the case’s charging port; the right hand then releases and shifts the case slightly to the right.
